name: GetMany
description: Performs a vector similarity search on a PostgreSQL database using pgvector to retrieve the most relevant records based on a given text prompt.
author: @rahmat

fields.name: __CredentialId__Postgres
fields.label: PostgreSQL Credential
fields.description: Select the credentials required to connect to the PostgreSQL database that hosts the pgvector-enabled table.

fields.name: tableName
fields.label: Table Name
fields.description: Specify the name of the PostgreSQL table containing the vector embeddings.

fields.name: prompt
fields.label: Prompt
fields.description: Input text used to generate an embedding and perform the similarity search.

fields.name: limit
fields.label: Limit
fields.description: Defines the maximum number of similar records to return.

fields.name: vectorColumns
fields.label: Vector Column Mapping
fields.description: Provide column names for the vector store in the exact order: id, content, metadata, embedding. Use a comma-separated list (e.g., id, content, metadata, embedding). This order is required for correct field mapping.

fields.name: vectorColumns
fields.label: Specify Embedding Column
fields.description: Enable this option to explicitly provide the name of the column in your PostgreSQL table that contains vector embeddings. This field is required for proper connector functionality.

fields.name: __ModelConfig__Embedding
fields.label: Embedding Model Config
fields.description: Configuration for the embedding model used to convert the input prompt into a vector representation.

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: Returns the top matching records ranked by similarity to the input prompt.
